I need to decide whether to buy New York Avenue or start an auction.

I have a yellow monopoly and $751 cash. I'm weighing whether to buy New York Avenue or auction it.

A prior thought planned to buy New York Avenue on a 7 roll from Electric Company, but the current state shows $751 cash and zero houses on the yellow monopoly. The earlier plan may not have executed.

I did not build on the yellow monopoly. Player 1 owns St James Place and Tennessee Avenue, leaving New York Avenue unowned.

Blocking player 1's orange monopoly is the key reason to buy New York Avenue. A completed orange set with houses would cost $100 per house and yield heavy rent. Player 1 has $513 cash and would bid aggressively for the property.

New York Avenue costs $200. Player 1 has only $513, so they cannot afford three houses on the orange set. I should buy it immediately to block their monopoly. Auctioning would let them acquire the property for nearly all their cash and complete the set.

Player 3 holds a light blue monopoly with hotels on Oriental, Vermont, and Connecticut. Rents there are $550 to $600. After buying New York Avenue for $200, cash drops to $551. Mortgaging Park Place adds $175, giving $726 in liquid assets. This covers the $600 hotel cost with $126 remaining. I will buy the property now.

I will buy New York Avenue and block player 1's orange monopoly. I will keep the public message brief.
